subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice timing & prioritized disbursement request

Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial onboarding docs + payment terms ask

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. We've attached our completed vendor onboarding form and W-9. Lumina typically invoices Net 45, but because this is our first engagement with Redwood and we need to align ramp costs, we wanted to request prioritized disbursement for the first two invoices (payment within 10 business days of invoice receipt). After that, we can move to Net 45.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can support a one-time accelerated disbursement for onboarding invoices, and what documentation you need to approve it? We can also accept a partial advance if that simplifies things.

Attachments: Lumina_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf, Lumina_W9.pdf

Thanks,
Ethan Brooks
Head of Partnerships
Lumina Works

Hi Ethan —

Appreciate you sending these over and welcome aboard. Looping in David (Procurement) and Marissa (Finance) to evaluate the one-time prioritized disbursement. Quick answers so you know what we'll need:

- Procurement will validate onboarding forms and PO flow.
- Finance will review credit/advance for first invoices and confirm payment channel (ACH vs. wire).
- If an accelerated disbursement is approved, we'll need a short proposed schedule and the invoices flagged as "onboarding" on receipt.

David/Marissa — can you review Lumina's onboarding form (attached) and advise whether Redwood can approve a one-time expedited pay for the first two invoices? If helpful, Ethan can share a proposed disbursement schedule (they suggested 10 business days).

Karthik
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial onboarding docs + payment terms ask

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed the onboarding form and W-9 — everything looks standard. A few notes:

- Our default new vendor terms are Net 45.
- We can make exceptions for accelerated disbursements on a case-by-case basis with approvals from Finance.
- Required for approval: a signed vendor agreement or a DocuSign envelope, a short disbursement schedule, and confirmation of bank details.

Marissa, can Finance confirm whether a one-time 10-business-day disbursement for the first two invoices is acceptable and whether we prefer an advance or fast-turn settlement? If approved, Procurement will label PO and invoice metadata for expedited routing.

Best,
David Kim
Procurement Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@lumina-works.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial onboarding docs + payment terms ask

Hi all —

After reviewing Lumina's request and risk profile, Finance can approve a one-time prioritized disbursement for the first two onboarding invoices under these conditions:

1) Lumina signs the standard vendor agreement (DocuSign link below).
2) The first two invoices are marked "ONBOARDING - PRIORITY" in the invoice header.
3) Lumina provides the proposed disbursement schedule (we received the sample spreadsheet attachment; please confirm actual dates).
4) Payment will be via ACH; if wire is required, Lumina covers the wire fee.

If Lumina accepts those conditions, Finance will fast-track payment to T+10 business days from invoice receipt for those two invoices. Subsequent invoices will follow Net 45. Procurement will set PO metadata to trigger expedited routing.

DocuSign: DocuSign: 0f8e3a-onboard-lumina
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-onboard-lumina
